structured_output.what_is_happening: A 12-minute-old pump.fun coin, "FearOfMovingOn" ($fomo), has already graduated to PumpSwap. It spiked to about $205k market cap (ATH price 2.06e-4) and is now crashing. At trigger it was $70k, and by collection it was $46k: -55% on DexScreener over 5 minutes and -72% on GeckoTerminal over 5 minutes. That puts it about 77% below its ATH. In the last 5 minutes sellers outnumber buyers (485 vs 394 unique). The dev status is "creator_close", meaning the creator has sold out. GMGN flags 69 bundler wallets and 404 fresh wallets. A copycat token with the same name has already been deployed.

narrative.description: The name is an emotional pun on the generic FOMO meme ("Fear Of Moving On"). The project lists an X handle and a .top website but has no DexScreener profile and no description. No distinct story or catalyst is visible in the packet.
narrative.why_spreading: Early pump.fun momentum and a fast graduation drew about 860 unique buyers in 15 minutes. The spike looks like launch-mechanics trading, not a story that is spreading. The price is now collapsing from its peak.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the original pump.fun mint and the one with the actual trading activity. The copycat with the same name (AFHDV...) was created about 7 minutes later and has no liquidity.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 other FOMO-ticker tokens exist, including an exact-name copycat launched minutes after this one. The ticker is extremely generic.

authenticity.evidence: Breadth is real: 861 unique buyers and 734 unique sellers, with top-10 holders at only 13.7% excluding the AMM. Against that, there are 69 bundler wallets, 404 fresh wallets, 19 snipers and 6 rat traders, and the dev has sold. Volume of $630k against a $46k market cap is extreme turnover, consistent with bot and snipe churn. There is no paid promotion.
authenticity.uncertainty: I cannot see X posts. GMGN rate fields are low, so the bundlers may already have exited, which fits the dump.

structural_risks: 69 bundlers and 404 fresh wallets; a coordinated early exit is visible in the price
Liquidity is only about $18.6k and falling
The price is in an active crash from ATH, and 5-minute sells outnumber buys
The generic ticker is exposed to copycats

structured_output.counterargument: The LP is 100% burned, mint and freeze authority are renounced, and holders are spread out, so a liquidity pull is impossible. Nearly 900 real buyers came in within 15 minutes. After a violent 75% flush, graduated coins sometimes bounce back toward their prior high. Returning to $93k would still be less than half of the $205k ATH, and the website plus X handle give a community some chance to rebuild.

structured_output.thesis: This is a typical graduate-then-dump pattern: a fast pump to about $205k, then the dev and bundlers exit, and the price crashes about 77% within minutes. The burned LP makes a hard rug unlikely, but most volume is churn and the momentum is sharply negative. A 2x from about $46k needs a strong reversal and fresh demand, and the packet shows no catalyst for either. My most likely outcome is a slow bleed or chop.
